Semantic summary: a battle-presentation sub-effect in the same 0x03001eec 'battle work' subsystem as member_orbit/run.c, taking a target pointer and a fixed-point (x, y) center directly as arguments rather than reading a per-member work-dispatch slot. Sets BG2PA=0x80, clears BG2X, and sets BLDCNT=0x3F46 (alpha blending, which the template does not touch), then seeds three 28-byte particle-record arrays with randomized polar-coordinate velocities around the given center: 64 records at work+0x7080, 3 evenly-spaced-by-angle records at work+0x772C, and 64 more at the fixed EWRAM address 0x02010000. Runs 72 frames; each frame optionally draws a frame-indexed sprite near the center (frames 0-47), then independently walks the three arrays with a countdown/expiry mechanic, drawing whichever entries are still alive through one of the two generated rectangle-blit callbacks, and calls a member-related helper (Func_080e6d3c) for frames 0-35.
